packageRules.description: Never touch `engines.node`. It declares the range of runtimes a package SUPPORTS, not a dependency to pin: the global `rangeStrategy: pin` rewrites it to the exact version Renovate happened to run on, which warns on install for every consumer on another Node and hard-fails under `engine-strict`.

Patch, minor and pin bumps merge on their own once CI is green. These are the ones `release.yml` turns into an automatic patch release. `pin` is its own update type in Renovate rather than a flavour of patch, so it has to be named here or the initial pinning PR sits open forever.
Majors are reviewed by hand, and merging one by hand means no automatic release either.

A GitHub Actions bump changes nothing a consumer installs, so it merges on its own and never cuts a release. Its updates arrive under the `github-actions` manager rather than as a dependency depType, so the rules above do not reach them. Majors still wait for a person.
A peer range is the compatibility window this package advertises. Widen it rather than pinning it, and never without a human deciding the window is really that wide.
